title: Process Flow Diagram Spec
description: Declarative input for generate.js. Produces one standalone HTML process-flow diagram matching the template.html design system.

subtitle.description: One-line purpose, shown under the title.

footer.description: Footer credit line. Defaults to title.

slug.description: Filename stem for PNG/PDF export. Defaults to a slug of title.

interactive.description: Opt into the interactivity layer (§11.3): focusable nodes, a click-to-detail side drawer showing each node's role, description and inbound/outbound edges, and type filter chips. Off by default — when false none of that CSS/markup/script is emitted, so the file stays byte-identical to the static design system. Turn it on for diagrams meant to be explored in a browser; leave it off for diagrams destined for a deck, a PDF, or print.

prerequisites.description: Items shown in the dashed PREREQUISITES band at the top of the canvas (spread horizontally). Also used as the Prerequisites card if cards.prerequisites is omitted.

flow.description: Ordered nodes laid out left-to-right. Each item is one node; connectors between consecutive items are generated automatically and coloured by the SOURCE node.

id.description: Optional stable id; referenced by loops[].from / loops[].to.

variant.description: end only: render as a rose-stroked negative terminal.

kind.description: step only: drives colour + default glyph. manual=emerald 👤, automated=violet ⚡, integration=amber 🔗.

role.description: step only: label above the box, e.g. '👤 Business Owner'. Defaults to glyph + kind.

title.description: step: box heading. decision: diamond text (string or array of up to 2 lines).

desc.description: step only: up to 3 description lines inside the box.

num.description: step only: badge number. Auto-increments (1,2,3…) if omitted.

edgeLabel.description: step/start: payload label on the OUTGOING connector, e.g. 'intake form'.

meaning.description: step only: a brief explanation of what this step or node means or accomplishes. Shown in the interactive drawer when interactive=true.

inputDesc.description: step only: description of input data or prerequisites flowing into this step. Shown above the inbound edges in the interactive drawer.

outputDesc.description: step only: description of output data or results flowing out of this step. Shown above the outbound edges in the interactive drawer.

example.description: step only: a concrete example of this step or node in action. Shown in the interactive drawer when interactive=true.

edgeMeta.description: Optional metadata attached to the OUTGOING flow connector from this node (rendered when that connector is clicked in the interactive drawer). Free-form: routingPurpose, condition, triggerEvent, dataTransferred, businessMeaning, downstreamImpact are recognised and grouped; any other key still renders under Additional Details.

wrapMeta.description: Optional metadata attached to the OUTGOING row-wrap connector from this node (a rowbreak continuation), rendered the same way as edgeMeta when that connector is clicked.

yesLabel.description: decision only: label on the in-lane (yes) branch. Default 'Yes'.

no.description: decision only: the negative branch. Supply EITHER `to` (route it to a node the flow already models) OR `label` (synthesise a reject terminal below the diamond). Prefer `to` when the failure path leads somewhere the process already has a node for: synthesising a second node with the same name duplicates it on the canvas and filters it as a terminal rather than as the step it actually is. `to` must name an existing node id; an unknown id is rejected before rendering.

to.description: Id of an existing node to route the negative branch into. Mutually exclusive with `label`.

label.description: Text for a synthesised reject terminal. Default 'Rejected'. Ignored when `to` is set.

meta.description: Optional metadata for this negative-branch connector, rendered when it is clicked in the interactive drawer. Free-form: routingPurpose, condition, triggerEvent, dataTransferred, businessMeaning, downstreamImpact are recognised and grouped; any other key still renders under Additional Details.

noLabel.description: decision only: label on the downward (no) branch. Default 'No'.

outcomes.description: decision/gateway only: structured branch-level detail shown in the interactive drawer's Decision Logic group — one card per outcome. Each item is free-form (label, condition, to, businessImpact, exceptionPath, escalationPath are recognised field names; any others still render). This is presentation detail for the drawer only — it does not affect layout or routing, which is still driven by `no`/`yesLabel`/`noLabel` and the flow order.

decisionLogic.description: decision/gateway only: plain-language explanation of how the outcome is determined. Shown in the interactive drawer's Decision Logic group.

evaluationCriteria.description: decision/gateway only: the criteria evaluated to reach an outcome. Shown in the interactive drawer's Decision Logic group.

ruleExpression.description: decision/gateway only: a rule expression or validation formula (e.g. 'score >= 80'). Shown in the interactive drawer's Decision Logic group.

wrapLabel.description: rowbreak only: label on the dashed wrap connector into the next row. Default 'continue'.

items.$comment: additionalProperties is intentionally true: the interactive drawer (references/interactive-drawer-guide.md) is metadata-driven and renders ANY field placed on a flow node, not only the named properties above. Add domain fields freely — actor, owner, sourceSystem, targetSystem, businessRules, validationRules, preconditions, postconditions, dependencies, upstreamImpact, downstreamImpact, kpis, slas, audit, documents, or any other name — and it will appear in the drawer automatically. See the guide for the full list of names that get a dedicated, labelled group.

loops.description: Extra edges (loop-backs / exceptions) drawn as dashed routed paths between two nodes referenced by id.

style.description: cycle=cyan, revision=emerald, exception=rose, plain=slate. Default plain.

route.description: under = channel below the flow (default); over = channel above the boxes.

meta.description: Optional metadata for this loop/exception connector, rendered when it is clicked in the interactive drawer. Free-form: routingPurpose, condition, triggerEvent, dataTransferred, businessMeaning, downstreamImpact are recognised and grouped; any other key still renders under Additional Details.

cards.description: The three reference cards below the diagram.

ioTable.description: DEFAULT card (Mode A1) — the Input · Output · Example · Meaning table. One row per transformation stage. When present, this single card replaces the three-card set. `example` auto-derives from the leading input→output terms if omitted.

io.description: Fallback three-card mode: Inputs → Outputs bullets.

tools.description: Fallback three-card mode: Tools & Integrations bullets.
